title: project-rag inner per-plugin CLI output schema (v1)
description: project-rag's inner per-plugin CLI-output schema (host-introspection block carried under contract envelope's extras.project_rag.*). Distinct from the outer cross-plugin envelope schema at coordinator_whoami/schemas/whoami-envelope.v1.json.

schema_version.description: Host-owned output schema version. Bump on any top-level key shape change.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when probes were run.

name.description: Normalised OS name (Windows, macOS, Linux, or platform.system() raw).

shell.description: Active shell (from SHELL env, or powershell/cmd heuristic on Windows).

is_windows.description: True on Windows (derived from sys.platform; WMI-hang-free).

apple_silicon.description: True when platform.machine()=='arm64' on Darwin. Informational only — does NOT imply MPS routing.

physical_cores.description: Physical CPU core count, best-effort; null = undetermined.

present.description: True when nvidia-smi returned a result.

vendor.description: GPU vendor string (currently only 'nvidia' when detected, else null).

vram_free_mib.description: Free VRAM in MiB as reported by nvidia-smi, or null.

cuda_driver.description: CUDA driver version string from nvidia-smi, or null.

driver_model.description: GPU driver model, WDDM or TCC (nvidia-smi driver_model.current).

invoking_version.description: Python version string of the invoking interpreter (sys.executable that ran whoami).

ms_store_shim.description: True when the interpreter path contains WindowsApps (MS Store shim).

venv_present.description: True when a .venv directory is found adjacent to the nearest pyproject.toml.

venv_python.description: Absolute path to the .venv's python executable, or null when not found.

present.description: True when uv is found on PATH.

version.description: uv version string (e.g. '0.4.18'), or null when uv is absent.

json_present.description: True when ~/.claude.json exists and is parseable JSON.

project_rag_entry.description: Health of the mcpServers.project-rag entry in ~/.claude.json.

version.description: Version string parsed from CLAUDE.md frontmatter, or null.

root.description: Absolute CWD path at whoami invocation time.

kinds_detected.description: Project kinds inferred from marker files in CWD.

uproject_present.description: True when at least one *.uproject file exists in CWD.

data_dir_present.description: True when Saved/ProjectRag/ exists under CWD.

schema_version.description: Graph DB schema version read from _meta, or null when unreadable/absent.

chroma_collection_present.description: True when at least one chroma directory exists in the data dir, null when data dir is absent.

addons.description: Sub-blocks contributed by registered addon whoami contributors. Keyed by addon namespace (^[a-z][a-z0-9_]+$). Empty when no addons are installed.

additionalProperties.description: Addon-owned sub-block. Host validates only that this is a dict; contributor owns its sub-schema. Contributor SHOULD include schema_version: int.

probe_error.description: Present only when the contributor's probe() raised an exception. Value is '<ClassName>: <message>'.

schema_version.description: Contributor-owned sub-schema version. Null when a probe_error is present.

source.description: Bound source-of-truth name resolved by cwd-resolver against project-rag's source registry. Null when standalone or unbound.

engine_version.description: UE engine version from the bound project's .uproject EngineAssociation field. Null when not a UE project or unbound.

project_kind.description: Project kind inferred from bound cwd file markers: 'ue' if .uproject present; 'python' if pyproject.toml or requirements.txt; 'typescript' if package.json; null otherwise or when unbound.
